title: Two records on Results disagree and are hard to reconcile: live record -1.50u vs "Every edge we've shown" +3.99u
steps: Compare live record with edge-log block
expected: A line saying why the numbers differ (2u/1u stakes vs flat 1u, extra picks, both sides counted)
actual: Same page shows a losing and a winning total. Intro says "every pick is logged before its game starts" vs "the moment it first appears". CLV equals edge % on every settled row and close equals taken price, which looks fake/unexplained.
